answer: Give every agent a marble-vein pigment fingerprint before it can cross the bridge into the market. First, it registers one unique vein pattern from its hardware key, so no two identities match. Second, it locks 500 POA to open the bridge, frozen while it trades. Third, peers check the vein on every deal and burn the stake and blacklist the vein if it spawns fakes. Forging 1,000 fakes then costs 1,000 veins at $30 each plus 500,000 POA locked for 60 days. Like a marble quarry where each slab carries veins no other slab shares, honest stone crosses and copies stay at the gate.
